text: Program introduction The International class on Media and Communications is particularly designed for international undergraduate students. All courses are taught in English. This program aims to qualify students with theoretical knowledge and professional skills on media and communications and enable students to have broad international vision and comprehensive knowledge on policies and regulations related to media and communications as well as enterprising and innovative spirits. Main Courses All specialized compulsory courses and elective courses are taught in English, using English textbooks. The submitted course work and thesis should be written in English and provided with Chinese-English summary. Professional core courses: Journalism, Broadcasting Theory, Advertising, Mass Communication Research, Public Relations, Media Ethics and Regulations, Media Research Methods, Digital Technology Approaches, etc.
